job.job_description:
Role Summary

A strong hands-on developer who executes the build alongside the senior engineer: implementing assistants, RAG pipelines, and integrations to specification and iterating quickly on feedback. Attends daily stand-ups on the US Central pattern and connects with US stakeholders as needed, while the senior engineer fronts the business relationship.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain LLM-powered assistants and supporting services on the clients platform components.
Implement RAG pipelines: document ingestion, pre-processing, embedding, index/vector-store creation, retrieval integration and testing.
Build integrations between assistants, ML model endpoints, data sources, and enterprise systems via APIs and connectors.
Support model-integration tasks under the senior engineers direction, including evaluation harnesses and regression checks on assistant behaviour.
Participate in daily stand-ups and sprint ceremonies; deliver iteratively against a fast-changing, lightly documented backlog.

Must-Have Skills

Solid Python engineering; REST API development and consumption; JSON/data wrangling; Git workflows.
Hands-on LLM app development: prompting, assistant configuration, function/tool calling, basic evaluation.
Practical RAG implementation experience with at least one vector database / embedding stack.
Working understanding of ML model concepts sufficient to integrate and test predictive models (does not require model-research depth).
Reliable US Central shift availability for stand-ups and intermittent stakeholder connects; collaborative, feedback-driven working style.

Good-to-Have

Exposure to forecasting/analytics use cases; commercial or pharma domain familiarity.
Cloud services (AWS preferred), containerisation basics, CI/CD; automation/orchestration platform exposure (e.g., UiPath).


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
